description: Allowed materials for dress classify and materials apply. Each id maps to an existing solid colour in generation.default.json or detail.default.json. The committed catalogue has no texture files (kind stays procedural). materials apply writes a snapshot with kind file after a CC0 download. wood_door and wrought_iron stay pending.

materials.name: Historic cream plaster
materials.description: Warm cream stucco for historic or unknown walls in the Murcia centre.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 as greyscale modulation (coral_fort_wall_02). File paths appear only after materials apply.

technical.notes: Safe default for historic walls when stone is not tagged. 2 m repeat so coral_fort modulation reads as plaster, not 4 m stripes.

materials.name: Ochre plaster
materials.description: Saturated ochre used on many residential facades in the current palette.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 as greyscale modulation (coral_fort_wall_02). File paths appear only after materials apply.

technical.notes: Residential walls only; not for religious stone. 2 m repeat with the cream plaster slot.

materials.name: White plaster
materials.description: Neutral white plaster. Safe fallback when context is unknown.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Warm limestone
materials.description: Warm stone for tagged stone walls, public buildings and religious volumes.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to rock_wall_11 (generic CC0 stone, not the Cathedral).

technical.notes: Prefer when OSM building:material is stone or limestone.

materials.name: Light stone
materials.description: Cooler light stone alternative for walls.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to rock_wall_11 (generic CC0 stone).

materials.name: Red brick wall
materials.description: Brick only when OSM tags building:material=brick. Not the default Murcia facade.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to red_bricks_04. Unused unless OSM says brick.

materials.name: Terracotta roof tile
materials.description: Red tile colour for pitched or tagged tile roofs.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to clay_roof_tiles_02. Not used on flat roofs.

technical.notes: Use when roof:material is tile or the roof is hipped.

materials.name: Grey flat roof
materials.description: Neutral flat roof. Safe fallback when pitch and OSM roof tags are missing.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

technical.notes: Neutral safe roof. Greyscale concrete_wall_001; colour stays on _BaseColor.

materials.name: Warm flat roof
materials.description: Warm gravel-like flat roof used by the current residential templates.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

technical.notes: Residential flat roofs. Same greyscale concrete as flat_roof_grey.

materials.name: Asphalt carriageway
materials.description: Dark asphalt for vehicular streets.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to asphalt_02. File paths appear only after materials apply.

technical.notes: OSM surface=asphalt wins over inference. Not cobble. 10 m so one repeat is wider than a lane.

materials.name: Cobblestone paving
materials.description: Warm paving for pedestrian streets, plazas and tagged sett or cobblestone surfaces.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to cobblestone_color. Applied only to surface/pedestrian_cobble after the generate OSM paving split.

technical.notes: Prefer when OSM surface is sett, cobblestone or paving_stones.

materials.name: Plain pedestrian paving
materials.description: Concrete for the pedestrian mesh that OSM did not tag as sett, cobble or paving stones.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to concrete_floor_02. Not the cobble split.

materials.name: Concrete sidewalk
materials.description: Grey sidewalk generated from the carriageway offset. Origin is generated unless OSM has a sidewalk tag.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to concrete_floor_worn_001.

materials.name: Neutral ground
materials.description: Residual ground after the planar partition.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Curb stone
materials.description: Carriageway boundary walls.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to rock_wall_11.

materials.name: Vegetation
materials.description: Parks, gardens and tagged green landuse.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Water
materials.description: Fountains and tagged water.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Wood door
materials.description: Existing door colour. No carved-wood texture file is in the repository.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to wood_planks. The JPEG stays in the texture cache; it is not committed.

materials.name: Wrought iron
materials.description: Dark metal for railings and some street furniture. No iron texture file exists.

textures.note: Colour exists (railing_metal). A wrought-iron texture file does not; marked pending.

materials.name: Urban metal
materials.description: Generic metal for lamps, bollards, benches and bins.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Tree trunk
materials.description: Trunk colour for generic tree prototypes.

textures.note: Bound in texture_plan.murcia_0.1 to bark_brown_02.

materials.name: Tree canopy
materials.description: Canopy colour for generic tree prototypes.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.

materials.name: Dark glass
materials.description: Window glass colour from the facade templates.

textures.note: Colour only. No glass texture file.

materials.name: Stone frame
materials.description: Opening reveals and balcony slabs.

textures.note: Solid colour plus optional generated atlas tile. No photo file.
